build_add_maskformer2_config: build a detectron2 config node with MASK_FORMER model settings and Swin backbone defaults
build_add_maskformer2_video_config: build a detectron2 config node with video segmentation, open-vocab, and referential grounding settings
configure_maskformer_loss_weights: configure maskformer loss weights including dice, mask, and generation loss coefficients
